samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>Fractional frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by 3.5 using double-edge clocking technique.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        Divides the input clock by 3.5 using double-edge clocking technique. Counts 7 clock cycles and generates two uneven clock periods: one with 4 source clock cycles and another with 3 source clock cycles. In the next cycle, phase-shifted versions of the divided clock are generated. One phase is delayed by half a clock period, and the other is advanced by half a clock period. Finally, the two intermediate clocks are logically OR-ed to produce the final fractional divided clock output, ensuring the divided clock signal has a uniform period.
    </implementation>
</module>
